acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the changelog page
acceptance_criteria.then: they see a right-aligned 'Back to top' link in muted text
acceptance_criteria.when: they scroll to the bottom of the list

acceptance_criteria.given: the 'Back to top' link is visible
acceptance_criteria.then: the viewport smoothly scrolls to the top of the page heading

assumptions.assumption: The 'heading' refers to the top-most H1 or title element of the changelog page.
The link should be part of the main changelog content flow rather than the global site footer, as it is requested 'under the last entry'.

clarified_description: Add a plain text 'Back to top' link at the bottom of the changelog page. The link should be right-aligned, positioned immediately following the last changelog entry, and use muted styling. Clicking the link will trigger a smooth scroll to the top of the page heading.

constraints.detail: The link must reside within the page flow (not fixed/floating) to comply with existing architectural patterns.

must: The system shall render a 'Back to top' link on the changelog page.
The system shall display the link text exactly as 'Back to top'.
The system shall position the link immediately after the last `ChangelogEntry` component.
The system shall right-align the link within the changelog container.
WHEN the link is clicked, the system shall perform a smooth scroll to the top of the page heading.
outcome: Users can quickly return to the top of the changelog page via a text link located at the end of the entry list.
rationale: The user requested a specific, lightweight navigation aid for the changelog. By placing it specifically under the last entry rather than in the global footer, we provide context-specific utility. Using muted styling and no icons follows the existing design language seen in `ChangelogEntry.tsx`.
should: The system shall apply muted text styling to the link (e.g., using `text-zinc-500` or `dark:text-zinc-400` to match existing changelog patterns).

user_stories.so_that: I can quickly jump back to the top without excessive manual scrolling
user_stories.want: a 'Back to top' link at the end of the changelog

jobs_to_be_done: Navigate back to the top of the page to access other navigation elements
users.name: Sandbox Site Visitor
pain_points: Manual scrolling required after reading long lists of entries

wont: The system shall not use an icon for this link.
The system shall not use a floating or fixed position for the link.
